description: List activity on a Wise profile, newest first: card payments, transfers, conversions, cashback, direct debits. Amounts are positive numbers; `direction` is in/out/neutral (neutral = between your own balances). `title` is the merchant or counterparty. Filter with `type`, `since`/`until` (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) and `search`. If `next_cursor` is returned, pass it as `cursor` (with the same filters) for older results. Use `resource.id` of TRANSFER items with get_transfer for details. Default profile: personal.

profile.description: Profile id from list_profiles, "personal", "business" or part of the profile name

search.description: Case-insensitive text match on merchant/title/description (scans up to 2000 items; may return slightly more than limit)

since.description: Only on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp)

status.description: Only activity in this state, e.g. UPCOMING for pending card payments

type.description: One of card, transfer, conversion, direct_debit, cashback, interest, or a raw Wise monetaryResourceType (e.g. CARD_TRANSACTION)

until.description: Only on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp)

name: get_transactions

direction.description: in, out or neutral (between your own balances)

title: Get Wise transactions
